svg.text: Build tissue representations that are intervenable and interpretable by design (Aim 1)
vocabulary for interventions, names for features
trained on spatial atlases and spatial perturbation screens (Perturb-CAST, CRISPRmap, Perturb-FISH, Perturb-map)
counterfactual queries on the tissue graph
cell placed into a new niche
scored on held-out tissues and contexts, at gene level,
effects and features, validated by intervention
the cell vs its niche, per programme
an interpretation counts only if steering the feature
features that are nameable and whose steering shifts
the predicted response become the targets to test
open, live benchmarks for tissue representations (Open Problems)
observational: validated interactions, curated by LLM agents
